shortDescription: TÜRK ALTIN İŞLETMELERİ BIST:TRALT:Source text for Workspace:Further company coverage:

children: SAYS, IT DECIDES TO BUY ALL SHARES OF SINDIRGI MADEN ISLETMELERI FOR 65.5 MLN USD AND SIGNS DEAL WITH SHAREHOLDERS
IT WAS PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED TURK ALTIN SIGNED DEAL TO BUY SIX MINES AND ONE ORE PROCESSING PLANT FROM COMPANY FOR 69.9 MLN USD
IT WAS DECIDED TO BUY ALL COMPANY SHARES INSTEAD OF ITS ASSETS AFTER REVIEW
OBTAINED ASSETS ASSESSED TO HAVE 76.049 OUNCES OF GOLD AND 1.8 MLN OUNCES OF SILVER RESERVES ACCORDING TO UMREK REPORTS
